great_nebula.title: Capricorn's Great Nebula
description: A large nebula in the centre of Capricorn's Galaxy
thought to be caused by the Nexus.
Travel to the nebula is extremely dangerous due to its high activity, making it
a perfect place for hiding all kinds of interesting regions like the Val Conjunct.

nexus.title: The Nexus
description: An area of extreme cosmic activity in the eye of The Great Nebula.
Traversing here is thought to be impossible. Hides the Ajankajo System.

ajankajo.title: Ajankajo
description: A mysterious system hidden in the Nexus.
Travel to here can be deemed impossible due to extreme
cosmic activity caused by the Emitter.

capricorns_great_union.title: Capricorn's Great Union
description: The most powerfull union in the galaxy.
The union is made of lots of smaller independent factions.
Tophu acts as the unions administrative capital system.
